adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a real guard mismatch. `refreshOAuthTokens` only uses the credential-sync endpoint when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (so team-owned creds with `userId` null take the native refresh path). But `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to `minimumTokenResponseSchema` whenever `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (no `userId` check), so the native provider refresh responses for team creds will be parsed with the “minimum” schema. That schema is not `.passthrough()`, so it will drop unknown fields like `refresh_token`/expiry fields, then the helper forcibly sets `data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"`. In Office365 (`packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`), the parsed data is spread into `o365AuthCredentials` and persisted via `prisma.credential.update`, which would overwrite the real refresh token with the literal string, breaking subsequent refreshes (data loss).
